COMMANDER:

Use the provided Commander reference image as the strict primary character reference.

Preserve the Commander's facial identity, hairstyle, age, body proportions, clothing, armor design, weapon design, and overall appearance exactly as shown in the reference.

The Commander is calm, disciplined, authoritative, and emotionally restrained.

He treats this as a normal military operation.

Do not alter his appearance.

Do not make him look more sinister or villainous.


=== CHARACTER COUNT ===

There are THREE important foreground characters:

1. Riven
2. Ally Soldier
3. Commander

Other ordinary allied soldiers may appear naturally in the background of the military camp.

Create all background soldiers from text only.

Background soldiers must look like ordinary members of the same army.

Give them varied faces, hairstyles, body proportions, armor details, and equipment.

Do not use Riven as a background soldier.

Do not use Ally Soldier as a background soldier.

Do not use Commander as a background soldier.

Do not duplicate any important character.

Only ONE Riven exists.

Only ONE Ally Soldier exists.

Only ONE Commander exists.


=== ENVIRONMENT LOCK ===

Use the provided Military Command Camp at Night reference as the strict environment reference.

Preserve the camp exactly as established in the reference.

Preserve the command tent, planning area, rough wooden table, military tents, crates, barrels, weapon racks, supplies, banners, worn ground, surrounding mountain terrain, nighttime lighting, practical fires or lanterns, and overall environmental atmosphere.

Do not change the camp into another location.

The military camp is active and preparing for an upcoming operation.

Some carry equipment or supplies.

Some check weapons.

Some organize crates and military equipment.

Some move between tents.

Keep all background activity secondary to Riven, Ally Soldier, and Commander.

No enemy soldiers.

No attack on the camp.

16:9 cinematic widescreen.

Feature-film quality.

Realistic human anatomy.

Natural human movement.

Realistic armor and weapon weight.

Natural facial expressions.

Speak the written dialogue exactly as written.

Do not translate the dialogue.

No additional spoken dialogue.

No background conversations.

Natural accurate lip synchronization.

No subtitles.

No captions.

No text.

No watermark.

No logo.


=== GLOBAL ACTION ===

Riven and Ally Soldier attend a military briefing at the command area of the camp.

The Commander gives them a new mission.

A village is believed to be sheltering enemy forces.

The army has been ordered to move at first light.

Riven does NOT yet know which village the Commander is talking about.

She does NOT know that the target is her home.

Ally Soldier does not know either.

For both of them, this initially appears to be a normal military assignment.

Do not reveal the village in this scene.

Do not show Riven recognizing anything.

The discovery happens later.


=== SCENE ===

Begin inside the active military command camp at night.

The Commander is already standing beside the rough wooden planning table near the command tent.

Riven and Ally Soldier approach the command area together.

Around them, ordinary allied soldiers continue preparing equipment and supplies throughout the camp.

Riven and Ally Soldier stop in front of the Commander.

The Commander looks toward them.

His manner is calm and professional.

Commander:

"We have new orders."

Riven and Ally Soldier listen attentively.

The Commander briefly turns his attention toward the planning table.

He naturally indicates the military map or planning materials in front of him.

Commander:

"A village is sheltering enemy forces."

Riven remains calm.

She shows no recognition.

She does not react emotionally.

For Riven, this still sounds like an ordinary military mission.

Ally Soldier also listens normally.

The Commander looks back toward them.

Commander:

"We move at first light."

Allow the conversation to settle naturally.

Riven briefly looks toward the planning table.

Then she gives a restrained professional nod.

Ally Soldier also acknowledges the order.

The Commander returns his attention to the military preparations.

The briefing is complete.

Riven and Ally Soldier turn away from the planning area.

They begin walking away together through the camp.

Do not add more dialogue.

Around them, ordinary allied soldiers continue preparing for the operation.

Some carry supplies.

Others check weapons or organize equipment.

Riven and Ally Soldier move naturally through this activity.

Riven remains calm and professional.

She still has no idea that the village mentioned by the Commander is her home.

CUT.


=== END STATE FOR CONTINUITY ===

Riven and Ally Soldier have received their new military orders.

They know that a village is believed to be sheltering enemy forces.

They know the army will move at first light.

Riven does NOT know that the target is her home village.

Ally Soldier does NOT know either.

Riven has not questioned the order.

There is no conflict between Riven and Commander yet.

The army continues preparing for the operation.

The identity of the village remains unrevealed.


=== MOOD ===

Professional.

Controlled.

Military.

Quietly serious.

This should feel like a normal military briefing.

Do not make Commander appear evil.

Do not make Riven suspicious.

Do not make Ally Soldier suspicious.

Do not create an exaggerated dramatic reaction.

The important idea is simple:

Riven receives the order normally because she does not yet know what village the army is going to attack.
